answer: Each identity must burn a proof-of-work beacon before its first answer, and the nonce binds to a wallet that already holds a peer-signed bond. A sybil farm pays that bond per clone, so its cost scales linearly while a real operator pays once; rebroadcasting the same beacon is rejected as a duplicate. At each epoch zenith the schedule draws graders only from bonded lanes, so a fresh comet of clones arrives with zero seats and zero yield until peers attest them socially.
